playing: Move cards to build the foundations

tutorial.foundation: There are eight foundations, two per suit. An Ace opens one, and each builds up A to K by suit. Completing all eight wins.
tutorial.stock: The stock is not turned one card at a time — you deal **eight at once**, one onto every column. There is no waste pile.
tutorial.tableau: Eight columns. Cards stack down in alternating colour and a run moves as a unit. **An empty column takes only a King** (or a run headed by one).
tutorial.waive: Once the stock is exhausted you may waive: lift one run aside, free the cards underneath, then put it back. Dealing and a second waive are both barred while you hold it.
tutorial.controls: Use the deal, hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.
